description: This file defines the RDKShell class, which provides an interface for managing and interacting with shell clients, including window management, event handling, and system information. It includes method declarations, event definitions, and internal classes for event listening, task queuing, and screen capturing within the RDKShell plugin for WPEFramework.

classes.name: RDKShell
classes.description: Main class providing shell management, event handling, and system interaction functionalities within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: RdkShellListener
classes.description: Listener class for handling RDKShell events such as application lifecycle events, user inactivity, and system warnings.

classes.name: MonitorClients
classes.description: Notification class for monitoring plugin client states and lifecycle events.

classes.name: ScreenCapture
classes.description: Implements the ICapture interface for capturing screenshots of the shell environment.

classes.name: TaskQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe queue for managing asynchronous tasks within RDKShell.

classes.name: PluginData
classes.description: Holds plugin-specific data, such as class name.

classes.name: PluginStateChangeData
classes.description: Handles plugin state change events and manages plugin connection lifecycle.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends an event notification with parameters.

methods.name: launchRequestThread
methods.description: Handles launching API requests in a separate thread.
